title: LDAP / BloodHound Enumeration (Active Directory)
description: A single Samba Active Directory Domain Controller for BRIGHTWELL.LAB (Brightwell University), no Windows VMs. Any authenticated user can read the directory over LDAP: a service account (svc-moodle, the Moodle LMS sync account) carries its own password in its description attribute, and a nested group chain (IT-Staff -> Registry-Admins) grants it the only path to a protected share. From the foothold user s.adeyemi, enumerate the directory with ldapsearch / nxc / BloodHound, recover the leaked credential, follow the nested group path, and read the flag from the registry share only Registry-Admins may open.
question: Enumerate Active Directory over LDAP from the s.adeyemi foothold, recover svc-moodle's password from its description attribute, follow the nested group path to Registry-Admins, and read the flag from the //dc/registry share.
